text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with BTC leading the decline at -2.0%, signaling mild pullback pressure across the two largest cryptocurrencies. The Fear & Greed index sits at 28—firmly in fear territory—and has strengthened by 4 points over the week, suggesting investor sentiment is cooling rather than stabilizing. Bitcoin dominance holding at 56% and $48B in daily volume indicates the broader market is still functioning with reasonable liquidity, but the shift toward fear alongside twin declines suggests risk-off positioning rather than conviction buying at these levels.
